prompts.poses: Create a four-frame animation sprite sheet for this exact Qing painting ensemble. Reference is sole visual identity source. A SINGLE horizontal strip of FOUR EQUAL SQUARE SLOTS, transparent background, 4:1 canvas. Each slot contains the same seated ochre-clad drummer with drum AND the same standing blue-clad cymbal player behind him, preserve relative positions and shared bottom baseline, same silhouette/palette/scale. Remove grey-clad man, pillars, curtain, floor, instruments not held by these two, other scenery. Frame1 source idle drummer sticks near drum and cymbals apart; frame2 drummer lifts hands subtly and cymbals approach; frame3 sticks tap drum and cymbals meet; frame4 hands return and cymbals separate. Heads, hats, faces, legs and drum stay identical in all frames. Very small plausible hand motion, no jumping. Muted silk watercolor, delicate ink exactly source style, do not modernize. Even generous clear margins in every equal slot. No labels text borders shadows or diagrams. Entire pair acts as one stable sprite group.
prompts.background: Edit the reference crop in its same exact portrait aspect ratio and composition to produce an unobtrusive background repair plate for animation. Remove ONLY the seated ochre-clad drummer, his drum and the standing blue-clad cymbal player immediately behind him. Retain grey-clad man and his object, pillars, pink curtain, architectural floor and rail exactly unchanged. Reconstruct only the occluded silk painting wall/floor matching original modest hand-painted lines and faded colors. No new objects. No text. This is an explicitly generated interpretation background, not original artwork.
prompts.watcherPortrait: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: historical-painting game recognition portrait. Reference image: the supplied native painting head crop, sole identity evidence. Create a conservative watercolor and fine ink tracing of ONLY this person's head, hat/headdress and beard if visible, isolated on transparent background. Preserve EXACT head turn, hat silhouette, facial hair silhouette and face proportions from reference. Do not infer sharp eyes or new facial marks from blurred pixels. No shoulders, garment, pole, props, wall or surroundings. Muted Qing painting colors, flat hand-painted appearance, not modern portrait, not photoreal. Leave generous transparent margin. This is explicitly an interpretive tracing, not a restored original. Save project asset; no text.

inspection: Original stage crop and source implementation inspected. No browser playback, seam, alignment, device or reduced-motion execution performed.
